DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お振り込みの金額についてですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about the amount you want to transfer?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。一回の上限より多いので、二回に分ければ今日全部送れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 一回上限を二回分割で超えられるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. It's above the limit for a single transfer, so can I send it all today if I split it into two?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether splitting into two transfers lets you exceed the single-transfer limit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 一回と一日の条件は別に確認が必要です。まだ操作は始めていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-03.translation: We need to check the per-transfer and daily conditions separately. Have you started the operation yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 始めていません。一回を小さくすれば一日の合計には制限がないと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未操作で一日合計の条件を未確認だと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-04.translation: I haven't. I thought that if I made each transfer smaller, there would be no limit on the day's total.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you have not started and show that you have not checked the daily-total conditions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご利用方法の条件を担当へ確認します。相手は分割の入金を了承していますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check the conditions for your transfer method with the staff member. Has the recipient agreed to receive split payments?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 聞いていません。二回に分けるなら、相手の照合方法も確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 相手の分割了承も未確認だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-06.translation: I haven't asked. If I split it into two, I'd also like to check how the recipient will match the payments.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that the recipient's agreement to split payments is also unconfirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 同日の利用条件と、相手が求める支払いの形式を分けてご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please discuss the same-day usage conditions separately from the payment format the recipient requires.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。振込のメモに同じ請求番号を付けることだけで、相手が二回分を正しく扱うとは決めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 請求番号だけで相手の照合成功を前提にしない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I won't assume the recipient will handle both payments correctly just because I put the same invoice number in the transfer notes.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Do not assume the invoice number alone ensures successful matching by the recipient. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: まず条件をご案内します。今すぐ一回目だけを実行することはご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-09.translation: First, I'll explain the conditions. Would you like to carry out just the first transfer right now?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: しません。銀行の条件と相手の了承がそろってから、方法と回数を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 両側の条件確認まで一回目も実行しないと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-10.translation: No. I'll decide on the method and number of transfers only once the bank's conditions and the recipient's agreement are both confirmed.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide not to make even the first transfer until both sides' conditions are confirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: そのご相談として担当へご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll refer you to the staff member for that inquiry.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 発送の料金は、差出人払いをご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like the sender to pay the shipping fee?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 買ってくれる人へ送るので、着払いにします。それで商品代も受取人から集めてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 着払いで送料と商品代を両方回収できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm sending it to someone who's buying it, so I'll use recipient-paid shipping. Will that collect the product price from the recipient too?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether recipient-paid shipping can collect both shipping charges and the product price. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この場面での着払いは送料の支払いです。商品代の回収とは別に相談が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-03.translation: In this scenario, recipient-paid shipping means payment of the shipping fee. Collecting the product price requires a separate inquiry.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 送料と代金を一緒に回収すると思っていました。商品代はまだ受け取っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 商品代は未受領で送料と混同したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought you would collect the shipping fee and product price together. I haven't received the product payment yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the product price is unpaid and you confused it with shipping charges. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 商品代の支払い方法は相手と確認してください。送料の負担は相手と決まっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please confirm the product payment method with the recipient. Have you agreed who pays the shipping fee?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 決まっていません。商品を買うと言っただけで、着払い送料まで了承したとは言えませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 購入同意と着払送料の了承を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-06.translation: We haven't. Just saying they'll buy the product doesn't mean they've agreed to pay recipient-paid shipping too, does it?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish agreement to buy from agreement to pay shipping on receipt. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。発送条件を先に確認しましょう。今日はまだ受付を進めないご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-07.translation: That's right. Let's confirm the shipping conditions first. Would you prefer not to proceed with accepting the parcel today yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 待ってください。商品代の方法と送料負担を相手へ確認してから、発送を決めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 受付を保留して両支払条件を相手へ確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please wait. I'd like to decide on shipping after checking the product payment method and shipping responsibility with the recipient.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Hold acceptance and explain that you will check both payment conditions with the recipient. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その後、対応できる発送方法と料金をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-09.translation: After that, we'll explain the available shipping methods and charges.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。着払いという言葉だけで両方決済できると伝えず、二つを分けて合意します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 商品代と送料を別々に合意してから発送相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I won't tell them that the term recipient-paid shipping alone means both payments can be settled. I'll agree on the two separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Agree separately on the product price and shipping fee before discussing dispatch. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認できましたら、発送条件をご相談ください。今は荷物をお返しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-11.translation: Once you've confirmed, please discuss the shipping conditions with us. I'll return your parcel for now.

DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 仕上がったコートはこちらです。

DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 腰のベルトがありません。コートと一緒に預けたと思うので、確認できますか。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: ベルトが見当たらず預けた記録の確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-02.translation: The waist belt is missing. I think I handed it in with the coat; could you check?
DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the belt is missing and request a check of the intake record. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お預かり時の付属品記録を確認します。ベルトを外して渡したか覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check the accessory record from when we received it. Do you remember whether you removed the belt before handing it over?

DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 付けたまま渡した記憶ですが、確かではありません。紛失したと決める前に控えを見てほしいです。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 記憶は不確かと伝え紛失断定前に控えを示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-04.translation: I remember handing it over attached, but I'm not certain. Before deciding it's lost, I'd like you to look at the receipt.
DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that your memory is uncertain and show the receipt before declaring it lost. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 控えには付属ベルト一点とあります。別に仕上げて保管されていないか担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-05.translation: The receipt says one accompanying belt. I'll ask the staff member whether it was finished and stored separately.

DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 自分の記憶だけでなく記録にもあるのですね。このコートの受付番号で探してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 受付番号で付属品の所在確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-06.translation: So it's in the record as well as my memory. Could you look for it using this coat's intake number?
DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for the accessory's location to be checked using the intake number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 番号で確認します。隣にある似た色のベルトは、別のお客様の物です。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll check by number. The similar-colored belt next to it belongs to another customer.

DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: それを代わりに受け取ることはしません。自分の番号の確認が済むまで、コートもここで見せたまま待ちます。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 他人の類似品を代用せず照合を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't take that as a replacement. Until the check for my number is finished, I'll wait with the coat still here for you to see.
DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Wait for matching without substituting another person's similar item. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が該当番号の付属品を持ってきました。こちらが記録のベルトです。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-09.translation: The staff member has brought the accessory for that number. This is the belt in the record.

DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: コートに合わせて確認します。付属品もそろったことを確かめてから、一緒に持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: コートとベルトの組を確認して受け取る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check it against the coat. I'll take them home together after making sure all the accessories are there too.
DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the coat and belt as a set before collecting them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ではコートとベルトを一緒にお渡しします。受付の控えもご確認ください。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I'll give you the coat and belt together. Please check your intake receipt too.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご注文前に確認したいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything you would like to check before ordering?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: そばを避ける必要があります。写真のそばの実だけ抜けば、この麺料理を頼めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: そば回避のためトッピング除去だけで頼めるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I need to avoid buckwheat. Can I order this noodle dish if you just remove the buckwheat grains in the photo?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether removing the topping alone lets you order while avoiding buckwheat. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: トッピングだけでなく、麺や調理条件も確認する必要があります。まだ注文は通しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: We need to check the noodles and cooking conditions as well as the topping. I won't put the order through yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 写真の粒だけを見ていました。麺そのものの材料も含めて、担当に説明を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 麺材料を見落としたと認め担当の説明を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I was only looking at the grains in the photo. I'd like an explanation from the staff member that includes the ingredients of the noodles themselves.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Acknowledge overlooking the noodle ingredients and request the staff member's explanation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 調理担当を呼びます。別の麺へ替えるご希望もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll call the cooking staff. Would you also like different noodles as an alternative?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 替えれば大丈夫と自分で決めません。別の麺でも、調理場所や器具について確認してから考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 別麺も適合を決めず調理条件を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I won't decide for myself that changing them makes it fine. Even with different noodles, I'll consider it after checking the preparation area and utensils.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Do not decide alternative noodles are suitable; check the cooking conditions too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その条件も伝えます。対応ができるとここでは保証できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll pass on those conditions too. I can't guarantee here that we can accommodate them.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では候補を先に確定せず、避ける必要がある内容を担当へ伝えます。同行者にもまだ私の分を注文しないよう頼みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 注文を保留し同行者の代理注文も止める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I won't finalize an alternative first. I'll tell the staff member what I need to avoid, and ask my companion not to order for me yet too.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Hold your order and stop your companion from ordering on your behalf too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 説明を聞いた後で、注文するかを決められます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can decide whether to order after hearing the explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。トッピング変更だけでは済ませず、材料と調理の説明を聞いてから自分の注文を判断します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 材料と調理説明後に自分の注文を判断する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I won't settle it with a topping change alone; I'll decide on my own order after hearing about the ingredients and cooking.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide on your order after the ingredients and cooking explanation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当が来るまでお待ちください。今のご希望を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please wait for the staff member. I'll tell them your current request.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 目の症状と、今気になっていることを教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please tell me your eye symptoms and what concerns you now.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 左目に違和感があります。コンタクトが外れたと思うのですが、どこへ行ったか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 左目の違和感とコンタクトが外れたと思うが所在不明と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: My left eye feels uncomfortable. I think my contact lens came out, but I don't know where it went.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report left-eye discomfort and that you think the contact came out but its location is unknown. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 外れたことを実際に確認したのですか。それとも見え方からそう思いましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Did you actually confirm it came out, or did you think so because of how you could see?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 見えにくくなったので、そう思いました。外れたレンズは見つけておらず、目に残っているかも自分では分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 見え方による推測で外れた現物と現在装着を確認していないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought so because my vision became blurry. I haven't found a lens that came out, and I don't know myself whether it's still in my eye.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that it is a guess based on vision, with neither the removed lens nor current wearing status confirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 装着中か不明という状態を診療担当へ伝えます。予備のレンズをもう着けましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll tell the clinical staff that you don't know whether it's still in. Have you already put in a spare lens?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだです。予備は未開封で持っています。外れたはずと決めて重ねて着けず、先に担当の案内を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 予備未開封を示し追加装着前に担当の案内を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Not yet. I have an unopened spare with me. Rather than assume the first one must be out and put another on top, I'd like the staff member's guidance first.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show that the spare is unopened and request staff guidance before putting in another lens. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 分かりました。最後に装着したことを確認できた時点と、その後の経過を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. Please tell us when you last confirmed putting it in and what happened afterward.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今朝七時に着けました。昼に見えにくくなりましたが、外した記憶はありません。装着時点と気付いた時点を分けて伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 朝七時装着と昼の変化を分け外した記憶がないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I put it in at seven this morning. My vision became blurry at midday, but I don't remember taking it out. I'll distinguish the time I put it in from the time I noticed the change.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish insertion at seven in the morning from the midday change and say you do not remember removing it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その経過を記録します。違和感のほかに、受付で伝えておきたい症状はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll record that sequence. Besides the discomfort, are there other symptoms you want to mention at reception?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 左目に赤みもあります。レンズが残っているからだとは断定せず、赤みと見え方、装着が未確認であることを説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 赤みを追加し原因を断定せず症状と未確認の装着状態を引き継ぐ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: My left eye is red too. I won't declare that's because the lens is still there; I'll explain the redness, vision and unconfirmed lens status.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Add redness without declaring a cause and pass on the symptoms and unconfirmed lens status. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 左目の違和感と赤み、今朝の装着、昼の見え方の変化、現在の装着状態は不明と記録しました。予備は未使用のままお持ちください。診療担当へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've recorded left-eye discomfort and redness, insertion this morning, the midday vision change and unknown current lens status. Please keep the spare unused with you. I'll pass this on to the clinical staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの席で準備できます。困るところはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You can get ready at this seat. Is anything difficult for you?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 左利きです。右手へ持ち替えないと、この体験には参加できませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 左利きで参加する条件を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm left-handed. Can I only join this activity if I switch to my right hand?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the conditions for participating left-handed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 使う手と準備の方法を先生に相談できます。今ここで無理に持ち替える必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can discuss which hand to use and how to prepare with the teacher. There's no need to force yourself to switch hands here now.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 左手で参加したいです。隣の方の袖へ腕が当たりそうなので、席の間隔も見ていただきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 左手希望と隣席の袖への接触懸念を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'd like to participate using my left hand. My arm might hit the sleeve of the person next to me, so I'd also like you to check the spacing between seats.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State your wish to use the left hand and your concern about touching the neighboring person's sleeve. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 先生が配置を確認します。隣の方の道具は動かさないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: The teacher will check the arrangement. Please don't move your neighbor's tools.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 動かしません。自分の墨も右側にあり、手を伸ばす時に袖が触れそうです。置場を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 他人の道具を動かさず自分の墨の置場を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I won't. My ink is on my right too, and my sleeve might touch it when I reach. I'd like to discuss where to place it.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Do not move someone else's tools and discuss the position of your own ink. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 自分の道具の置場も一緒に確認しましょう。墨を入れる前に、筆を持つ動きを示せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's check where your own tools go too. Before adding ink, can you show the movement you make holding the brush?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。空の筆で動きを見せます。先に墨を入れてから、隣の道具を避けようとするのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 墨を入れる前に空の筆で動きを示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I'll show the movement with a brush without ink. I won't add ink first and then try to avoid my neighbor's tools.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the movement with an uninked brush before adding ink. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 配置が確認できました。先生の案内で、ご自身の道具をこの位置へ準備してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We've checked the arrangement. Following the teacher's guidance, please prepare your own tools in this position.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この位置で袖が触れないかもう一度確認します。自分の道具だけ準備し、左手で始める方法を先生に聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 袖と配置を再確認し自分の道具だけ準備する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check again that my sleeve doesn't touch anything in this position. I'll prepare only my tools and ask the teacher how to start with my left hand.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Recheck the sleeve and arrangement and prepare only your own tools. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では先生と準備しましょう。隣の方の道具はそのままで大丈夫です。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then let's get ready with the teacher. Your neighbor's tools can stay as they are.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 会議室をご希望ですか。どのような用途でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like a meeting room? What would you use it for?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 近所の人と日本語を練習したいです。部屋を予約したら、参加者にも案内が届きますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 部屋予約で参加者への案内が出るか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to practice Japanese with people in the neighborhood. If I reserve the room, will participants be sent an invitation too?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether reserving a room results in invitations being sent to participants. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 部屋の予約だけで参加者への募集案内が出るわけではありません。主催者の方で準備する内容も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Simply booking a room doesn't mean participant recruitment notices will be sent. We'll also check what the organizer needs to prepare.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 施設が参加者を集める会だと思っていました。自分が主催する集まりとして、利用条件を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自分が主催する会として利用条件を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought it was a group where the facility recruited the participants. I'd like to ask about the usage conditions for a gathering I organize myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Discuss usage conditions for a gathering that you organize yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 人数の見込みと、活動内容を伺います。参加者はもう決まっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll ask about the expected number and activity. Have the participants already been decided?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだ決まっていません。最大十人を考えていますが、十人の申込みがあるとは伝えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 最大見込み人数と実際の申込未定を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Not yet. I'm thinking of a maximum of ten, but I won't say ten people have signed up.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish the maximum expected attendance from actual applications still being undecided. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 利用条件を確認しましょう。施設内で募集案内を掲示したい場合は、別に確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's check the usage conditions. If you want to post a recruitment notice inside the facility, that needs separate confirmation.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 部屋が取れたら掲示も許可されたとは考えません。自分の募集案を作ってから、掲示の条件を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 予約と掲示許可を分け募集案で相談すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't assume that getting a room also permits posting. I'll prepare my own recruitment draft and then discuss the posting conditions.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Separate booking from posting permission and say you will consult using a recruitment draft. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 部屋の申込み方法と掲示の相談先を分けてご案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: We can explain the room application method separately from where to ask about posting.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。参加者募集は自分で準備し、部屋の受付と掲示の可否をそれぞれ確認して進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 募集を自分で準備し二つの手続きを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I'll prepare participant recruitment myself and proceed after checking the room application and posting permission individually.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Prepare recruitment yourself and check both procedures. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では二つの案内をお渡しします。今は予約確定ではなく、条件のご相談として伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I'll give you both guides. For now, I'll take this as an inquiry about conditions, not a confirmed reservation.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 飲み物のご注文について確認させてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Let me check your drink order.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 隣の部屋の友人の飲み物も、私の端末で頼みました。店員さんが隣へ届けてくれると思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 隣室の飲み物を自室端末で頼んだと申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I also ordered my friends' drinks for the next room using my terminal. I thought the staff would deliver them next door.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report ordering the next room's drinks on your own room's terminal. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この端末の注文は、この部屋の注文として届いています。どの飲み物が隣の方の分ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Orders from this terminal have come through as orders for this room. Which drinks are for the people next door?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この二杯です。こちらの部屋の三杯とは分けたいです。まだ届いていないので、担当に確認してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自室三杯と隣室希望二杯を区別して確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: These two. I'd like to separate them from this room's three drinks. They haven't arrived yet, so could you ask the staff member to check?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish your room's three drinks from the two intended for next door and request a check. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 注文状況と扱いを確認します。隣の部屋の方にも、同じ飲み物を注文済みか聞いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check the order status and how to handle it. Please also ask the people next door whether they've already ordered the same drinks.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 友人に聞くと、隣でも二杯頼んでいました。重複していますが、取り消せると決めず状況を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 隣室でも注文済みと報告し取消可否を決めない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I asked my friend, and they had ordered two drinks next door too. They're duplicates, but I'll explain the situation without deciding they can be canceled.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Report that the next room also ordered and do not decide whether cancellation is possible. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 二つの部屋の注文を担当が照合します。追加注文は少しお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: The staff member will match the orders from both rooms. Please wait a little before ordering anything else.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 待ちます。届いた物を勝手に部屋間で移して解決せず、どちらの注文をどう扱うか説明を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 追加注文と勝手な部屋間移動を止める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll wait. I won't try to solve it by moving delivered items between rooms myself; I'll hear how each order will be handled.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Stop additional orders and unauthorized movement between rooms. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が説明に来ます。支払いも部屋ごとに確認する必要があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: The staff member will come to explain. Payment also needs to be checked for each room.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。自分の三杯と重複した二杯を区別し、注文の扱いと各部屋の会計を確認してから次を頼みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 飲み物の内訳と両部屋の会計を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll distinguish my three drinks from the duplicate two and check the order handling and each room's bill before ordering more.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the drink breakdown and bills for both rooms. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当へその内容を伝えます。二つの部屋の番号で照合します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll pass that on to the staff member. We'll match them using both room numbers.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの商品をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this the product you would like?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 薄いですが、本の表紙があるので、持ち帰れば読めると思って選びました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 表紙付きカードを読む本だと思って選んだと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: It's thin, but it has a book cover, so I chose it thinking I could read it when I took it home.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you selected a cover-bearing card thinking it was a book to read. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらは電子版を利用するためのコード商品です。紙の本とは違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: This is a code product for accessing an electronic edition. It's different from a paper book.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 中に印刷された本文がある商品ではないのですね。スマートフォンで使う条件を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 電子版コードの意味を確認し利用条件を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: So it isn't a product containing printed text inside. I'd like to check the conditions for using it on a smartphone.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm what an electronic-edition code means and ask about usage conditions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 利用するサービスや端末の条件は、商品案内を確認してください。紙の本をご希望でしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check the product information for the service and device requirements. Did you want a paper book?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 母へ渡すつもりでした。母がそのサービスを使えるか分からないので、私の端末で使えればよいとは考えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 母への贈答で本人の利用環境が未確認と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I planned to give it to my mother. I don't know whether she can use that service, so I won't assume it's enough that it works on my device.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that it is a gift for your mother and her usage environment is unconfirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 贈る方の利用条件が未確認なら、紙の本の在庫を確認することもできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: If the recipient's usage conditions are unconfirmed, we can also check stock of the paper book.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 同じ内容の紙版があるか調べてもらえますか。コードを開封して試すことはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同内容の紙版を探しコードを開封しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Could you check whether there's a paper edition with the same content? I won't open the code product to try it.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Look for a paper edition with the same content and do not open the code. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 紙版の版と内容を確認します。電子版と全く同じ構成かも説明を見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll check the paper edition's edition and content. Please also look at the explanation of whether its structure is exactly the same as the electronic edition.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。母が使える形と内容を確認してから選びます。今のコード商品はまだ購入しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受取人の利用形態と版の内容確認まで購入を保留する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I'll choose after checking a format my mother can use and the content. I won't buy the current code product yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Hold off buying until you have checked the recipient's usable format and the edition's content. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では紙版を確認します。コード商品は未開封のままお預かりします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I'll check the paper edition. I'll take back the code product still unopened.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご注文はお決まりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you decided on your order?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日の写真ではこの料理が品切れでした。今日は別の料理にしようと思っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 昨日の品切れ写真を理由に別料理を選ぶ予定を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: This dish was sold out in yesterday's photo. I'm thinking of choosing something else today.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you plan to choose another dish because yesterday's photo showed it sold out. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 写真は昨日の状態ですね。本日の提供状況を確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: The photo shows yesterday's situation. We can check today's availability.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昨日の品切れが続くと決めていました。今日もないのか、確認してから選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 当日の提供状況を確認してから選びたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I had assumed yesterday's sellout was continuing. I'd like to check whether it's unavailable today too before choosing.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask to check the day's availability before choosing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 本日はこの料理を提供できると担当から案内されています。内容の説明も必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: The staff member has told us this dish is available today. Would you also like an explanation of its contents?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。昨日の写真にある付け合わせと今日も同じか確認したいです。提供できることと内容が同じことは別ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 提供可否と付け合わせの一致を分けて確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I'd like to check whether today's side dish is the same as in yesterday's photo. Being available and having the same contents are different, aren't they?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check availability separately from whether the side dish matches. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 本日の付け合わせはこちらです。写真の野菜とは変わっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: This is today's side dish. It's different from the vegetables in the photo.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 違いが分かりました。友人と分けるので、今日の付け合わせを伝えて希望を聞いてから注文します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 当日の変更内容を同行者へ伝え希望を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I understand the difference. I'm sharing it with my friend, so I'll tell them today's side dish and ask their preference before ordering.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Tell your companion about today's change and ask what they prefer. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お返事が来るまで、注文はまだ通さずお待ちします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll wait without putting the order through until you have their reply.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 友人も今日の内容でよいそうです。この料理を一皿、今日の付け合わせでお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 同行者の了解後に今日の内容一皿を注文する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: My friend says today's version is fine too. One plate of this dish with today's side dish, please.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: After your companion agrees, order one plate with today's contents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。本日の内容を確認した一皿としてお受けします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll take it as one plate with today's contents confirmed.
